Blur Out

Image starts sharp and softens into a blurred state on hover/focus.

Hover or focus the image to see the effect.

HTML

<div class="hover-effect blur-out">
  <img src="image.jpg" alt="description">
</div>

CSS

.hover-effect.blur-out img{

  transition: filter 0.5s ease;
}
.hover-effect.blur-out:hover img,
.hover-effect.blur-out:focus-visible img{
  filter: blur(5px);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hover-effect.blur-out img{
    transition: none;
  }
  .hover-effect.blur-out:hover img,
  .hover-effect.blur-out:focus-visible img{
  filter: blur(5px);
  }
}

filter: blur(5px) on is applied on hover. Select the code and copy with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
